answer: Operator-funded exit escrow. Each operating entity posts a zephyr-funded escrow that covers a fixed refund per verified identity; duplicate or abandoned identities claim from it. On confirmed duplication, the escrow pays the refund and a penalty, and the operator must top it up before any new registration. A comet of review traffic tags the operator's remaining identities. Each duplicate attempt thus costs one escrow refill plus a crystal-clear loss of registration throughput.
